dialogue.speech: What?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Who are you?! How long have you been standing there?!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Wait! Who are you?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: What's that mark I can see on your neck?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Wh-What is this? What's going on?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Why did the arrow fall from my hands?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: You! I told you to stop!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Show me... your... face...

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Why am I sitting down?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Could it be... the arrow's...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Th-This feeling...

dialogue.speech: Everyone else is also...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: What's going... on...

dialogue.speech: No one can escape the fate that was chosen for them.

dialogue.name: No_one_can_escap,Op subs
dialogue.speech: All that remains is the end, where you will all perish.

dialogue.name: No_one_can_escap,Op subs
dialogue.speech: Eternal greatness exists only within myself.

dialogue.name: No_one_can_escap,Op subs
dialogue.speech: Sing a song of sorrow in a world where time has vanished.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Wh-What? Did I fall asleep?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What... happened?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: It's already dawn.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Yeah. I'm not sure why, but it seems like we've been asleep for a few hours...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Wh-What is this?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Why are my hands all wet?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Is this blood?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Wh-Why?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Were we attacked?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Are you hurt anywhere, Giorno?!

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sign
dialogue.speech: {\fad(,)\c&HC&\c&HF&}D{\c&HAA&}a{\c&HEA&}s{\c&HAAD&}h{\c&HAB&}!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Giorno! Get behind the wall!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: You're right out in the open!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: If you're hurt, you need to tend to your wounds!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I-Is Giorno hurt? I can't seem to see him anywhere.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Hurry up and hide, Giorno!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Wh-Where the heck is he anyway?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I can't see him at all from where I am.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Could you tell me where he is, Trish?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: If he's hurt, we need to go save him!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What the hell are you talking about?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Huh?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Nothing you're saying makes any sense.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Wha—

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What the hell is this?!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: H-Hey, what the hell is going on?!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Why do I have these things?!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: N-No, wait! I'm missing something!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: It's totally gone!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What I'm missing is way more important!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Hey, Giorno! What's up with the blood on your hands?!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Where the hell are you looking?! You! I'm talking to you!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Y-You're talking to me?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I mean, I was surprised earlier, but whatever this blood is, I don't feel any pain.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: It must be from when the mold attacked.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I had Giorno fix it for me, but the wound hasn't completely closed,

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: so I think the blood is from my shoulder.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: The mold's attack?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: But you...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What... in the world...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: happened?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Did I fall asleep?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I feel strange.

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&H&\c&HFCC&}Rumble

dialogue.name: Both
dialogue.speech: Wh-What the...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Th-This face...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: G-Giorno's body and my body...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: No, wait. It's our souls, our minds.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Could it be that while we were sleeping, Giorno and I, and Mista and Trish...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Each pair's minds have been swapped?!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What's with this face?!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: This body!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I stink!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: My armpits...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: smell so bad!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: H-Hey, come on, Trish!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: That's not the problem right now!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: We were attacked by a Stand.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: It's definitely not the boss's Emperor Crimson,

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Why me? No!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: but our minds have been swapped for some reason!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Damn it! Could it be another one of the boss's elite guard?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: No, Narancia.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: The boss is already somewhere near the Colosseum,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: so I don't think he'd rely on one of his subordinates.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Plus, Mista and Narancia mentioned an attack, but is that really what this is?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Our minds have been swapped, but we're not hurt.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: What could have...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: H-Hey, Giorno.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: No matter what happens, I-I'm still older than you. Got it?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Oh, my gosh! I have hair growing on my fingers!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: And my nails are so gross and malformed!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: And they have so much dirt under them!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I can't deal with this!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I knew it! That stinks, too!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Why? Why did I have to be Mista?!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: H-How am I supposed to know?!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Probably because we fell asleep near each other.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: And is that really what you think about me?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Do I smell that bad?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Hey!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What the hell are you touching there?!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: H-Hey, don't get the wrong idea!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I wasn't trying to touch it! It's just itchy around the elastic...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Don't stick your fingers in my panties!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Okay, I got it...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: If you spread your legs any further, I'll k*ll you.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Okay, I get it! But you're wearing panties to make your butt look firmer,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: so everything's so tight and itchy!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: You're even wearing a push-up bra.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Just so we're clear!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: The next time you stick your hand into my skirt, I'll k*ll you!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I'm going to

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: curse you to death!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Narancia!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Tch. Don't you get it? That's Giorno.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: And so what, you're going to k*ll yourself?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Stop that!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Hey, guys...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I, um, have a question.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: So, Bucciarati...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Um, so it's me and Giorno, and Mista and Trish.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: If we swapped minds with whoever was closest to us,

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: then who did Bucciarati...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I've been watching him, but he's not moving at all.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Is he okay?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Stay away from him, Narancia!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Huh?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: There should be someone else inside Bucciarati, too.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: And we don't know who that is.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Is that what you're saying, Giorno?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: It all comes down to what went down at this Colosseum before we got here.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Who was near Bucciarati?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: And what happened to the boss and the man waiting for us at the Colosseum?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Narancia, scout the area with Li'l Bomber!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I've been trying... but...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Something's wrong. Li'l Bomber isn't...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: M-My Stand ability...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Appear! Li'l Bomber!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: It's no use! Li'l Bomber won't come out!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: D-Don't tell me our Stands—

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: No, Narancia. That's not it.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Take a closer look.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Li'l Bomber!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I-It's so fast! It's so fast, I couldn't even see it!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: But what the hell?!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I don't know what's going on, but I feel so refreshed!

dialogue.name: B*ll*ts
dialogue.speech: I don't know what's going on, but...

dialogue.name: B*ll*ts
dialogue.speech: ...we're so full of energy!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: My Stand is still with me, but it seems to have powered up!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I destroyed six iron railings in a single shot!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: My mind is on point!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: What in the world is this Stand ability that can swap people's minds?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: What's the purpose of this?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This Stand user...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: As much as I don't want to believe it, are they our enemy?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: There's no one else nearby.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I can't tell if any of them are the boss.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Everyone around the Colosseum...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: is fast asleep.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Even with my radar, I can't really tell how far it reaches.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: No, wait...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Some of them are moving just a little bit.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Some are even waking up!

dialogue.name: Cop
dialogue.speech: Man, that was a great dream.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Wh-What the hell is this?!

dialogue.name: Cop
dialogue.speech: I assaulted some female cop and even handcuffed her.

dialogue.name: Cop
dialogue.speech: Tweet, tweety tweet.

dialogue.name: Guy
dialogue.speech: Arooo!

dialogue.name: Lady
dialogue.speech: Waaah! Waaah!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: So all the passersby got swapped, too?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Yeah, it looks that way. There's confusion everywhere.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: What a weird ability...

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Hey, Giorno. What are you doing?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I should be able to sense a soul's energy through the ground.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: But I can't... Who is it?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Who did Bucciarati swap with?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Narancia... I mean, Giorno.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: If you're thinking that the boss and Bucciarati got swapped,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: there's one thing that's clear.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: That's not it. That's definitely not the boss's soul.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: If it were him, I would be able to sense him.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: But the strangest thing is that I'm certain the boss isn't nearby, either.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: The boss disappeared somewhere.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You're saying we won't know about him until he wakes up?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Until then, we can't take our eyes off of him.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: It hurts...

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Without question, the enemy is Diavolo.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Got it?!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I-It hurts...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: But listen to me, Narancia... No...

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Are you Giorno Giovanna?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Golden Wind!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: No... I'm not speaking from inside the turtle.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: It's me. I'm the one speaking.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: My name is Jean Pierre Polnareff.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I was the one who arranged to meet you here at the Colosseum,

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: but Diavolo backed me into a corner,and I could no longer fulfill my promise.

dialogue.name: Who_swapped_with,Sign
dialogue.speech: Who swapped with who

dialogue.name: Mista___________,Sign
dialogue.speech: Mista Trish

dialogue.name: Mista___________,Sign
dialogue.speech: Giorno Narancia

dialogue.name: Mista___________,Sign
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati

dialogue.name: Mista___________,Sign
dialogue.speech: Turtle Polnareff

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Who the hell is this guy? Who's "Polnareff"?

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Let me just say this first...

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I only did this because Diavolo left me with no other choice.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: This strange phenomenon that's happening to all of you right now...

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: is a part of the arrow's power,the arrow I was supposed to give you.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I'm desperately hanging on to my soul... so I can tell you this.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: The arrow?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: So you're saying this was caused by that arrow?

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: To be more precise, it's because my Stand, Silver Chariot, took hold of the arrow.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: My body is already dead upstairs.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The reason I was able to swap souls with this turtle and survive is

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: because of that arrow.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: There's definitely someone in the hallway on the second floor.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: There's a dead guy who's been knocked out of his wheelchair!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: It's only my body? Where's Diavolo?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: Hey! If everything you're saying is true,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: your Chariot can return us to normal, too, right?

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: No... I currently don't have the power to control Chariot or make it disappear.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I don't even know where it is right now.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Chariot has basically gone berserk.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Your own Stand went berserk?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: How irresponsible can you—

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: No. More importantly, what happened with the boss?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: What happened to him?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Where is Diavolo right now?

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I don't know.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Diavolo was right in front of me, but he disappeared.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: All of you, listen very carefully.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The arrow is not your enemy, nor is it your friend!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: What I'm about to explain to you is hope!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Such a trivial... trivial coincidence happened two years ago.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: After I was incapacitated by Diavolo,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I somehow managed to survive and hid in a small farming village.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: That's where the trivial thing occurred.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The arrow we had retrieved in Egypt fell between the wall and some furniture.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: It's truly an insignificant thing.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Normally, one would just stick their arm back there and pick it up.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: But for my body, it was an arduous task.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I thought about just leaving it there,

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: but I figured that Chariot could get it for me.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: That's when it happened.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Chariot hurt its finger on the arrow.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: It was mere coincidence.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The arrow draws out Stands from those who have potential.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: But if it happens to pierce a Stand...

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I don't know how old that arrow is,

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: but I'm starting to understand what the person who created it was thinking.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: There's more to the power of a Stand!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Something that goes far deeper!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Suddenly, the birds in the sky fell,

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: bugs hid beneath leaves, and cattle laid on the ground.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: And the farmers started sleeping in the streets.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I felt a slight change, but a much bigger change had taken over Chariot.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I had a bad feeling, so I immediately took the arrow away from it...

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: before it could go berserk.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Everything went back to normal, as if nothing had happened.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Then I realized that if someone who had enough power were to use this arrow,

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: they would have the power to control the minds of all living creatures!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: But I currently don't have that kind of power.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: And that's why I waited...

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: for someone like you who was searching for Diavolo's true identity.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Though, in the end, Diavolo was able to outdo me.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: So this controlling minds thing...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Do you mean the thing going on right now?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: It's just swapping souls?

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: No.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Remember when I said that this was just a part of its power?

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I can't control it, so I wasn't able to see its potential beyond that.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: But it definitely exists!

dialogue.name: Turtrle
dialogue.speech: Go retrieve the arrow!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Stop Chariot before the boss can, and reclaim the arrow!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The only way to defeat Emperor Crimson

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: is for you to use the arrow to its full potential!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: So in order to take back the arrow, you're telling us to k*ll Chariot.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Am I assuming too much?

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: That's fine.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Once you take the arrow, Chariot will be destroyed regardless.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Besides, I've already been finished off.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: There's one other unbelievable and important thing that I need to tell you.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Are you the girl called Trish?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Yes, though I currently have hairy knuckles.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I see...

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The boss is a duo.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: There was a kid who was somehow able to transform into you and trick Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Diavolo and this kid were like a well-coordinated team.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What? B-But how?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: But that's impossible.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: The boss trusts no one. That's how he kept his identity secret for so long.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: I'm not sure what happened, either...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: But there was definitely a mysterious kid.

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: If it wasn't for that kid, there's no way I'd have let Diavolo get that close to me.

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Two... So the boss is a duo?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: What's...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Giorno! Something's moving!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Nine o'clock. Uno signal.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: It's a person!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: There's a person heading in from the gate on the right!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: H-He's...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: That face!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: The boss! No... Diavolo!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Narancia...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Get Li'l Bomber behind him—

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: Giorno, wait!

dialogue.name: Turtle
dialogue.speech: The left! Look to the left, in the shadows!
